**Reviewing and preparing local cleanup evidence**

远端公开 API 的匿名 REST 查询因仓库不可见而返回 404；Git transport 仍可核验，目标提交既不在普通 remote refs，也不在 `refs/pull/*/head`。现在检查本次门禁遗留的本地进程、监听端口、浏览器 profile、SSH tunnel 与临时目录，然后使用既有授权配置仅查询 Ubuntu 上的临时 Remote Host 资源和 JI 自身 Compose 状态。

title:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$evidence = '/export/user\.gold-band\projects\e-projects-code-ai-ji--a40d4379\tasks\task-015\runs\run-001\rounds\round-001\nodes\ai-dynamic\attempt-001\dynamic\nodes\phase-5-reaccept-after-three-blocker-fixes\attempt-001\attachments\independent-local-cleanup.log'
$ports = 4173,4175,4176,4177,18090,18091
$listeners = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in $ports })
$processes = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {
  $_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and $_.Name -match '^(java|node|ssh|chrome|msedge)\.exe$' -and
  $_.CommandLine -and ($_.CommandLine -match 'Stage5TopologyFixture|run-stage5-(real|remote)-topology|playwright[_-].*profile|ji-stage5-remote')
})
$tunnels = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {
  $_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and $_.Name -eq 'ssh.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -match '\s-L\s+127\.0\.0\.1:'
})
$tempItems = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'ji-stage5-remote-*' -or $_.Name -like 'ji-stage5-ubuntu-*' })
@(
  "timestamp=$([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o'))"
  "stage_listener_count=$($listeners.Count)"
  "stage_process_count=$($processes.Count)"
  "ssh_tunnel_count=$($tunnels.Count)"
  "stage_temp_item_count=$($tempItems.Count)"
) | Set-Content -LiteralPath $evidence
if ($listeners.Count -ne 0 -or $processes.Count -ne 0 -or $tunnels.Count -ne 0 -or $tempItems.Count -ne 0) { exit 1 }
Add-Content -LiteralPath $evidence -Value 'INDEPENDENT_LOCAL_CLEANUP_OK'
Get-Content -LiteralPath $evidence

title:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
$evidence = '/export/user\.gold-band\projects\e-projects-code-ai-ji--a40d4379\tasks\task-015\runs\run-001\rounds\round-001\nodes\ai-dynamic\attempt-001\dynamic\nodes\phase-5-reaccept-after-three-blocker-fixes\attempt-001\attachments\independent-remote-cleanup.log'
$configuration = @{}
foreach ($line in [IO.File]::ReadAllLines((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath '.env'))) {
  if ($line -match '^\s*([^#][^=]*)=(.*)$') { $configuration[$matches[1].Trim()] = $matches[2].Trim().Trim('"').Trim("'") }
}
$target = $configuration['JI_TEST_SSH_TARGET']
$key = [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]'JI_TEST_SSH_KEY']
$origin = $configuration['JI_TEST_RELAY_ORIGIN']
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($origin)) { $origin = 'https://ji.lilypad.com.cn' }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($target) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($key)) { throw 'Authorized Stage 5 SSH configuration is unavailable' }
$remoteCheck = @'
set -eu
remote_tmp_dirs=$(find "$HOME" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'ji-stage5-remote-*' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
remote_fixture_processes=$(pgrep -fc '[S]tage5TopologyFixture' || true)
remote_browser_processes=$(pgrep -fc '[c]hrom(e|ium).*(ji-stage5|playwright)' || true)
remote_stage_sqlite_files=$(find "$HOME" -maxdepth 5 -type f -path "$HOME/ji-stage5-remote-*/*" \( -name '*.db' -o -name '*.sqlite' -o -name '*.sqlite3' \) | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
if test -f "$HOME/ji-stage5-gate/source.tar.gz"; then remote_source_archive=present; else remote_source_archive=absent; fi
remote_host_service=$(systemctl --user is-active ji-host.service)
remote_host_enabled=$(systemctl --user is-enabled ji-host.service)
ji_compose_services=$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=ji-relay --format '{{.Label "com.docker.compose.service"}}' | sort -u | paste -sd, -)
printf 'remote_tmp_dirs=%s\n' "$remote_tmp_dirs"
printf 'remote_fixture_processes=%s\n' "$remote_fixture_processes"
printf 'remote_browser_processes=%s\n' "$remote_browser_processes"
printf 'remote_stage_sqlite_files=%s\n' "$remote_stage_sqlite_files"
printf 'remote_source_archive=%s\n' "$remote_source_archive"
printf 'remote_host_service=%s\n' "$remote_host_service"
printf 'remote_host_enabled=%s\n' "$remote_host_enabled"
printf 'ji_compose_services=%s\n' "$ji_compose_services"
test "$remote_tmp_dirs" -eq 0
test "$remote_fixture_processes" -eq 0
test "$remote_browser_processes" -eq 0
test "$remote_stage_sqlite_files" -eq 0
test "$remote_source_archive" = absent
test "$remote_host_service" = active
test "$remote_host_enabled" = enabled
test "$ji_compose_services" = ingress,relay,web
'@
& ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i $key $target $remoteCheck 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $evidence
$sshExit = $LASTEXITCODE
$statusCode = 0
try { $statusCode = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$origin/api/v1/health/ready" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10).StatusCode } catch { $statusCode = 0 }
Add-Content -LiteralPath $evidence -Value "public_ready_status=$statusCode"
Add-Content -LiteralPath $evidence -Value "INDEPENDENT_REMOTE_CLEANUP_EXIT=$sshExit"
if ($sshExit -ne 0 -or $statusCode -ne 200) { exit 1 }
Add-Content -LiteralPath $evidence -Value 'INDEPENDENT_REMOTE_CLEANUP_OK'

title:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$sourceDir = '/export/user\.gold-band\projects\e-projects-code-ai-ji--a40d4379\tasks\task-015\runs\run-001\rounds\round-001\nodes\ai-dynamic\attempt-001\dynamic\nodes\phase-5-complete-final-gate-evidence-commit\attempt-001\attachments'
$manifestPath = Join-Path $sourceDir 'artifact-sha256.txt'
$evidence = '/export/user\.gold-band\projects\e-projects-code-ai-ji--a40d4379\tasks\task-015\runs\run-001\rounds\round-001\nodes\ai-dynamic\attempt-001\dynamic\nodes\phase-5-reaccept-after-three-blocker-fixes\attempt-001\attachments\independent-artifact-sha256.log'
$results = foreach ($line in Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath) {
  if ($line -notmatch '^([0-9a-f]{64})\s{2}(.+?)\s{2}(\d+)$') { throw "Malformed artifact checksum entry" }
  $expectedHash = $matches[1]
  $name = $matches[2]
  $expectedLength = [int64]$matches[3]
  $path = Join-Path $sourceDir $name
  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path
  $actualHash = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $path).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
  [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $name; HashMatch = ($actualHash -eq $expectedHash); LengthMatch = ($item.Length -eq $expectedLength) }
}
$lines = @("timestamp=$([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o'))")
$lines += $results | ForEach-Object { "artifact=$($_.Name) sha256_match=$($_.HashMatch.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()) length_match=$($_.LengthMatch.ToString().ToLowerInvariant())" }
$lines += "artifact_count=$($results.Count)"
$lines += "mismatch_count=$(@($results | Where-Object { -not $_.HashMatch -or -not $_.LengthMatch }).Count)"
$lines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $evidence
if (@($results | Where-Object { -not $_.HashMatch -or -not $_.LengthMatch }).Count -ne 0 -or $results.Count -ne 25) { exit 1 }
Add-Content -LiteralPath $evidence -Value 'INDEPENDENT_ARTIFACT_SHA256_OK'
Get-Content -LiteralPath $evidence
